notes.note: Fix round 8 of the delivery-state change: the flush hook's deferred-row retry timer now re-reads the queue when it fires (arming itself for the next row still waiting) before starting its pass, so a second deferred row is not stranded when the first one's pass claims nothing; 'deferredAt' joins OutboundDispatchIntent's omitted fields. Only outboundQueue.ts's intent type changed ('deferredAt' omitted). This document's statement that a deferred message is retried once its wait ends now holds for every waiting row (the retry re-reads the queue). No prose change.
